facts.text: ClickBellEnv is registered as ClickBell with max_episode_steps=600
ClickBellEnv subclasses EmbodiedEnv, imported from the external embodichain package
ClickBellEnv.__init__ forwards cfg and keyword arguments to EmbodiedEnv and stores action_config when one is given
compute_task_state reads the button articulation's joint positions with get_qpos
The source comment describes button.urdf as a single prismatic joint with range [-0.005, 0.0]
press_depth is minus the button joint position
The ClickBell success threshold movement_threshold is 0.0048
The ClickBell success flag is latched within an episode with |= current_success
compute_task_state returns success, fail and the metrics press_depth and movement_threshold
is_task_success returns the latched success flag
reset clears the success flag for the reset ids, defaulting to every environment
ClickBellTest uses the smaller movement_threshold 0.004
The click-bell action configuration declares right_arm 6, left_arm 6, left_eef 1 and right_eef 1 action dimensions
The documentation states that an arm action dimension is 6 DoF and a gripper action dimension is 1
The legacy replay format stores the robot's 14 active CobotMagic joints
The click-bell random protocol sets max_episode_steps to 361
The click-bell random protocol sets control_freq to 25
The evaluation launcher passes the resolved max_episode_steps to gym.make
The observation configuration modifies the robot/qpos observation at joint ids 6 and 13
The OpenPI CLI defaults state_key to robot/qpos and image_key to color
The released evaluation records ClickBell success rates for the simulation checkpoints
prepare_episode_reset seeds Python random, NumPy and Torch; its docstring says EmbodiChain's reset(seed) seeds Torch only

determinism.notes: the package's fake seeds Python's random.Random from reset(seed) or cap.world.seed.v1 and repeats its placeholder start state for a seed; upstream reset(seed) seeds EmbodiChain, and the evaluation also seeds Python random, NumPy and Torch (scripts/eval_policy.py:301-315), so the upstream path is not reproduced; neither path was compared

gaps: the fake backend is an analytic contract stand-in for ClickBellEnv: it has no CobotMagic robot, no EmbodiChain/dexsim physics, no contacts, no camera and no torch, so it cannot move the button (press_depth stays 0 and is_task_success stays false); its action-to-observation transition and reset jitter are placeholders, not robot motion

the fake action space is a placeholder Box(-1, 1) with 14 values: the real space, its bounds and the joint order are defined by the external EmbodiChain EmbodiedEnv and the CobotMagic robot, which are not in the clone; action_space_ref is therefore unset and the derived bounds have no source
the fake observation is a placeholder dict with only the robot/qpos key (14 values); the real observation is produced by the external base and includes camera streams (sensor/<camera>/color)

the 14 action values come from the task's action_config and the replay helper, and the 361-step limit is the random protocol's max_episode_steps (configs/click_bell/random/gym_config.json:4); the class registration default is 600 (click_bell.py:34), and the fake uses the deployed protocol's 361

the fake treats one tick as 40 ms from the random protocol's control_freq 25; the EmbodiChain physics timestep and control decimation are not stated in the clone, so this is a recording period, not a sourced physics timestep
the fake reset accepts a seed but only draws a placeholder robot/qpos jitter with Python's random.Random; the upstream task randomizers and their seeds were not run or compared

the upstream simulator and the sim backend (gym.make('ClickBell')) were not run: they need EmbodiChain v0.2.4.post1, dexsim, a CUDA/Vulkan GPU, the CobotMagic assets and a cfg built by the EmbodiChain launcher (docs/getting_started/installation.md:3-93); only the fake backend is declared and checked; the external base's construction, stepping and native-stop semantics are unverified
snapshot and restore are not offered: the fake exposes no get_state/set_state and the bridge binds no cap.world.snapshot.v1

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: on the fake backend the software latch refuses step, reset and seed until mhs.safety.reset; the cached world state stays readable and reset of the latch does not advance it; no native stop or halted EmbodiChain simulator is established
